title: meeting-message-payload
description: One tagged union: every channel message about one meeting. The filed-note variant is the single definition site of the filed-note fields; the deferred-filed-note index entry names this same file and its instance sets the deferred discriminator.

oneOf.description: filed-note: the one-line note every processed meeting gets

destination.description: the path the filed-note line names

deferred.description: present on the filed-note of a previously withheld meeting, filed after a routing answer

oneOf.description: doubt: a glossary-unsettled term; the summary is already written with the best guess flagged

guess.description: the best guess now standing in the written summary

summary.description: the already-written summary carrying the flagged guess

oneOf.description: unroutable: no known destination matched; nothing was written; the owner is asked where it goes

signals.description: the candidate signals the owner needs to answer the routing ask

excerpts.description: short transcript passages that hint at who the meeting was with

oneOf.description: amendment: an already-filed summary changed wording; one-liner for the meeting's thread
